lines: Do you know how big the fish in the ocean are?
A new report says that fish are smaller than before due to global warming.
According to the research, most fish will become even smaller by the year 2050 because the ocean is getting warmer.
The biggest changes will be seen in tropical areas.
The scientists say that the fish cannot grow enough because there is less oxygen in warmer water.
They also say that many fish will move to cooler water outside the tropics.
Professor William Cheung said, “We found that the fish are much smaller these days.
It occurred over a short period of time.
It is known that fish respond to climate change.
Thus, it is very important to reduce greenhouse gases and control global warming.”
